name: webos-jetkvm
description: JetKVM browser console with hardware H.264 capture for rooted LG webOS TVs

scripts.build: npm run build:tv-app && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:ui: npm run prepare:ui && npm ci --prefix build/jetkvm/ui --ignore-scripts && npm run build:device --prefix build/jetkvm/ui && node tools/package_ui.mjs
scripts.format: npm run prepare:ui && python3 tools/quality.py format && npm run refresh:ui-patch
scripts.format:check: npm run prepare:ui && python3 tools/quality.py check-format
scripts.lint: npm run prepare:ui && python3 tools/quality.py lint
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:native && ctest --test-dir build/host --output-on-failure
